scope:
Replay compound literal and native-field queries at default and explicit depth.

Only TableCraft executes SQL. Exact Fraction/IEEE models and independent stored
getters supply expected values; this does not qualify native Access semantics.

diagnostic_attempts.note: A large intended Double used an integer token beyond the supported literal envelope. The constructor now uses explicit .0 spelling; runtime code and expected values are unchanged.
Initial successful controls crossed the default depth only six times. The final workload adds six retained CVar wrappers to every conditional arm to exercise deeper native-field composition as well.
